name: Loom Tension
description: The Post, the seat, the hum.

pages.title: Tension Post
pages.text: Logs, a Binding Knot, and a scrap of Thread make a **Tension Post**. Raise one on the pad. Right-click it with a Strand token to seat that Strand; the notch lights, the tribe chimes, and the Post starts to hum.

pages.title: What Tension does
pages.text:
Seated Strands are **Loom Tension**. It is not a bar and it does not nag. It changes the pad.

Near the Post: the pad mends you (Soil). It feeds you a little (Sprout). Fall damage stops within sight of it (Claw). Hands quicken (five Strands). Luck (Sigil). And the horizon warms, one Strand at a time.

pages.title: Spun at the Post
pages.text:
Two things are made at the Post, not the bench.

**Braid Cord**: right-click with a Strand Filament once two of Clock, Swarm, or Spark are seated.

**Spindle Loom Fragment**: right-click with a March stone once all nine are seated. Seat the Fragment to Reweave.
